solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

B028-02.notes: Remaining = x(2/3)(3/4) = x/2 = 30, so x = 60. Distractor $72 fits misreading 1/4 of original.

B028-03.notes: x^2 - (sum)x + product = 0 -> x^2 - 7x + 10; roots 2 and 5. Sign trap B.

B028-04.notes: Alternate interior angles equal: 3x+10 = 5x-30, x = 20, angle = 70. Distractors: x (20) and supplement (110).

flags: minor: some definitions of percentile use 'scored below' rather than 'at or below'; 'About' covers this, and no choice uses the strict version, so the key is still unique.
B028-06.notes: 80th percentile: about 80% scored at or below. A/B confuse it with percent correct; C reverses it.

B028-09.notes: Interior is (12-2)(15-2) = 10*13 = 130. 126 = 180 - 54 (perimeter count, corners double-counted); 150 = remove only one row and one column.

B028-10.notes: |x-2| = 3 -> x = 5 or -1; distance = 6. 3 is the half-width trap.
